response.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM station_averages) SELECT AVG(s.station_avg) AS mean_station_average, AVG(s.station_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess_above_baseline FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.station_avg > b.baseline_avg;
